infra-monitor-bot: 🔴 ALERT: GPU pool eu-west-1-a / pool-7 uptime=99.9% alloc=98% queued=312 avg_wait=3.8s admission_control=ENABLED(threshold=85%)
maya: seeing this on the dashboard now, is this customer-facing traffic or internal tests?
sam: mostly hosted API user traffic — we still have routing to eu-west-1-b/c but autoscaler hasn't caught up. queue growth started ~1m ago.
claire: dashboard snapshot: https://dash.redwood.ai/pools/eu-west-1-a/pool-7 — heatmap shows sustained 96-99% for 12m, batch size spiking.
david: any deploys or config changes in the last 30m that could explain the spike? product noticed some heavy embedding jobs earlier.
maya: embeddings usually cause long seq lengths, right — that would blow up effective capacity. can we identify sticky users and throttle?
sam: yep. admission control snippets: `rate_limit_by_capacity = floor(available_gpus * 1000 / avg_cost_per_request)` — already throttling at 85%. I'll toggle stricter admission for embeddings only.
claire: +1 for selective throttle. we should avoid global throttle — hit SLAs for chat gen.
infra-monitor-bot: NOTE: routing policy engaged fallback -> eu-west-1-b for new requests, but region_locality_penalty causing increased latency for some sessions.
maya: can we force immediate drain by increasing desired_count for pool-7 by 2 nodes? if autoscaler lagging we can trigger manual scale.
sam: running `infractl pool scale --pool pool-7 --delta 2` now. will monitor.
infra-monitor-bot: ACTION: scale command accepted, starting 2 instances (estimated ready 90s).
claire: also temporarily raised embedding admission to 60% -> 40% drop in embedding qps so far. queue depth down from 312 -> 190.
david: can we surface a quick cost note for ops? extra nodes = ~2.6 GPU-hours, rough cost $3.8/h. worth it to avoid customer errors.
maya: agreed. track on incident ticket. I'll create one and attach dashboard and runbook snippets.
sam: scale completed: instances online. queue depth 190 -> 48 over next 60s, avg_wait -> 0.9s. confirming steady.
claire: monitoring for 10 more minutes then close thread if stable. ping @oncall if relapse. :thumbsup:
infra-monitor-bot: RESOLVED: pool-7 allocation now 74% queued=46 avg_wait=0.8s admission_control=ADJUSTED -> 65%
maya: thanks team — follow-up: add per-model cost-aware admission thresholds to reduce future noisy-neighbor risk.
david: noted for next sprint (routing + cost controls).
claire: closing in 10.
